item.title: UMD graduate workers protest payroll failures at university president’s speech
item.description: The protest, organized by the university’s Graduate Labor Union, took place during university president Darryll Pines’ biannual State of the Campus address.

item.title: Maddie Komoroski has become a role model for Maryland gymnastics’ freshmen
item.description: Komoroski has mentored freshman Emily DeFrees, who is still learning to manage nerves before routines.

item.title: College Park will use AI-powered stop sign cameras to ticket drivers
item.description: The cameras use artificial intelligence and video technology to detect when drivers fail to come to a complete stop at intersections.

item.title: Maryland gymnastics bounces back, earns first place at Temple Quad Meet
